DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 免許の書類について、気になる点をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what concerns you about the license documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外国の免許では姓が先ですが、旅券では名前が先です。同じ人だと分かるように準備したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外国免許と旅券の姓と名の順序違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My foreign license has my surname first, but my passport has my given name first. I'd like to prepare so it's clear they're for the same person.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the different surname and given-name order on your foreign license and passport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずは担当窓口へ、二つの書類の表記が違うことを伝える必要があります。原本はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, you need to tell the responsible office that the names are written differently on the two documents. Do you have the originals?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方の原本を持っています。コピーだけを送るより、先に電話で相談したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの原本を所持すると伝え電話相談とコピー送付の順序を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both originals. Would it be better to ask by phone first rather than just sending copies?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have both originals and ask about the order of phone consultation and sending copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持参や送付の方法も担当窓口に確認しましょう。氏名以外にも違う記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check with that office how to bring or send them. Are there differences besides the name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 免許には古い住所が残り、在留カードの住所とも違います。名前と住所の二点を、電話でどう説明すれば伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 免許と在留カードの住所も違うため氏名と住所の説明文を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My license still has my old address, which also differs from my residence card. How should I explain these two points, the name and address, over the phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the license and residence-card addresses also differ and ask how to describe both name and address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 「氏名の順序は旅券と、住所は在留カードと異なります」と伝え、必要な確認書類を尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please say, 'The name order differs from my passport, and the address differs from my residence card,' and ask what verification documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その文をメモしました。訂正する前に、現在の書類で相談できるかも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明文を控え訂正前の書類で相談可能か聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've noted that sentence. I'll also ask whether I can consult using my current documents before correcting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the explanation and say you will ask whether consultation is possible with the documents before correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、自己判断で書類に書き込まず、担当者の案内を受けてください。運転の可否も別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Don't write on the documents yourself; follow the staff member's instructions. Whether you may drive also needs separate confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手続きの相談中は運転せず、バスで窓口へ行きます。案内された問い合わせ先を控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運転せずバスで訪問すると決め問い合わせ先を控えたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't drive while discussing the procedure; I'll go to the office by bus. I'd like to note down the contact details you've given me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to visit by bus without driving and ask to note down the contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問い合わせ先はこちらの案内で確認しましょう。相談が進むとよいですね、それではお気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the contact details in this guide. I hope your consultation goes well. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤をお持ちですね。機械の表示で迷っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have detergent with you. Are you unsure about the machine's display?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三番の機械に服を入れました。「洗剤不要」とあるのに、持って来た洗剤を入れそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三番の洗剤不要表示を読み違え持参洗剤を投入しかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've put my clothes in machine three. It says no detergent needed, but I nearly added the detergent I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you misread machine three's no-detergent sign and almost added your own detergent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ洗剤は入れていませんか。三番は洗剤が自動で入る機械です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't added any detergent yet? Machine three adds detergent automatically.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ袋を開けただけです。自分の洗剤はしまって、スタートしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗剤は未投入だと伝え持参洗剤をしまって開始可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've only opened the bag so far. May I put my detergent away and start it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say no detergent has been added and ask whether you may put yours away and start. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ふたを閉める前に、洗濯表示とポケットをご確認ください。機械には何を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before closing the lid, please check the care labels and pockets. What have you put in the machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 綿の作業着です。ポケットに耳栓を入れたままなので、いったん取り出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 綿の作業着に残った耳栓を洗濯前に取り出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Cotton work clothes. The earplugs are still in a pocket, so I'll take them out first.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the earplugs left in cotton work clothes before washing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 耳栓を取り出してからふたを閉めてください。支払いの前に選んだコースもご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please close the lid after taking out the earplugs. Check the selected course before paying too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 洗濯と乾燥のコースになっていますが、乾燥は自宅でしたいです。洗濯だけに変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乾燥は自宅でするため洗濯乾燥から洗濯だけへ変更を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's on a washing-and-drying course, but I'd like to dry them at home. I'd like to change to washing only.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to switch from washing and drying to washing only because you will dry them at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ支払っていないので、こちらの選択画面で洗濯だけを選び直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Since you haven't paid yet, please reselect washing only on this selection screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 洗濯だけの表示に変わりました。料金も画面で確かめたので、このコースで始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 洗濯だけの表示と料金を確認して開始すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The display has changed to washing only. I've checked the price on screen too, so I'll start this course.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the washing-only display and price and say you will start. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その表示なら洗濯だけです。お忘れ物のないようお受け取りください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: That display means washing only. Please remember all your belongings when collecting them. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。受け取りについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Would you like to ask about collection?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自宅のポストにこの票がありましたが、宛名は私ではありません。再配達を頼む前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票の宛名が自分と違うため再配達依頼前の確認を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice was in my mailbox at home, but the addressee isn't me. I'd like to check before requesting redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check before requesting redelivery because the notice is addressed to someone else. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名と、お住まいの住所がどのように違うかお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me how the name and your current address differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所と部屋番号は合っています。私は先月入居したので、前の住人かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所と部屋番号は一致し先月入居したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The address and room number are correct. I moved in last month, so it may be the previous resident.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the address and room number match and you moved in last month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前の住人かどうかは、こちらでも調べる必要があります。ご本人の荷物として受け取らず、票を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to investigate whether it's the previous resident too. Please let us check the notice without collecting the parcel as your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分宛てとして受け取るつもりはありません。この不在票を窓口に預けて調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分宛てとして受け取らず不在票を預け調査を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't intend to receive it as though it's addressed to me. Can I leave this notice at the desk for you to investigate?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not collect it as your own; leave the notice and request an investigation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、票の番号を確認します。差し支えなければ、現在のお住まいの氏名も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll check the notice number. If you don't mind, please tell me the name of the current resident too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は私、チャンが住んでいます。郵便受けにはまだ名前を付けていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現住人の姓チャンと郵便受けに氏名がない状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm Chan, and I live there now. I hadn't put my name on the mailbox yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the current resident's surname Chan and explain that no name is on the mailbox. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 氏名を伺いました。お調べするための連絡方法を、この用紙で確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've taken your name. Please let us confirm how to contact you for the inquiry on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼間は仕事中なので、電話に出られないことがあります。夕方に連絡を取れる番号を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昼間の応答困難を説明し夕方連絡できる電話番号を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm working during the day, so sometimes I can't answer the phone. I'll write a number where I can be reached in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain difficulty answering during the day and write a phone number for evening contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます、番号を確認しました。今日は票をお預かりします、それではお気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-IWAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you, I've checked the number. We'll keep the notice today. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 天井の木をじっと見ていらっしゃいましたね。何か気になるところがありましたか。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking closely at the wood on the ceiling. Did something catch your attention?

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あの太い木が曲がっているのは、古くなったからでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 曲がった梁が古さによる変形か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is that thick piece of wood curved because it's old?
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the curved beam is deformed by age. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 梁のことですね。この展示では、木の形を生かした組み方を紹介しています。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: You mean the beam. This exhibition introduces construction methods that make use of the wood's natural shape.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まっすぐな木だけを使うわけではないんですね。屋根を支える仕組みも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 曲がった材の利用を理解し屋根を支える仕組みを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: So they don't only use straight wood. I'd also like to know how the roof is supported.
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the use of curved timber and ask how the roof is supported. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小さな模型なら、柱と梁の位置を横から見られます。そちらで説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: With the small model, you can see the positions of the pillars and beams from the side. Shall I explain over there?

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。実物は高くて見えにくいので、模型と比べたいです。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 模型で実物と比較する説明を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. The real structure is high and difficult to see, so I'd like to compare it with the model.
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request an explanation comparing the model with the real structure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 模型の赤い部分が、今見た梁に当たります。触って動かす展示ではないので、指で場所を示しますね。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: The red part of the model corresponds to the beam you just saw. This isn't an exhibit for touching and moving, so I'll point to the position.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い部分の下に柱がありますね。この位置を写真に残してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 柱の位置を確認し模型の撮影可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a pillar under the red part. May I take a photo of this position?
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the pillar's position and ask whether you may photograph the model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 模型の撮影表示を一緒に確認しましょう。ここには撮影可とありますが、説明中のほかの方は写さないでください。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the model's photography sign together. It says photography is allowed here, but please don't include other people listening to explanations.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 模型だけ撮って、帰ってから梁と柱の関係を復習します。説明ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 模型だけを撮り構造を復習する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll photograph only the model and review the relationship between beams and pillars when I get home. Thank you for explaining.
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph only the model and review the structure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真を見るときは天井の高さも思い出してみてください。それでは、残りの展示もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: When you look at the photo, try to recall the ceiling height too. Please enjoy the rest of the exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 収穫用の箱は、列の端にまとめてあります。持っていく前に中を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The harvesting boxes are grouped at the end of the row. Please look inside before taking one.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一つだけ底に水が残っています。この箱を使っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 箱の底の残水を報告し使用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's water left in the bottom of just one box. Is it okay to use this one?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report water remaining in the bottom of a box and ask whether it can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その箱には、まだ実を入れないでください。乾いた箱と取り替えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please don't put fruit in that box yet. Let's replace it with a dry one.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 濡れた箱は、ほかの空箱と分けて置いたほうがいいですね。置き場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 濡れた箱を分ける置き場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I should put the wet box separately from the other empty boxes, right? Please tell me where to put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask where to put the wet box separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 洗い場の横の台へ置いてください。作業台の下には置かないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please put it on the stand beside the washing area. Don't put it under the workbench.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 洗い場の横ですね。乾いた箱も確認しましたが、実は何段まで重ねますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 交換した箱に重ねられる実の段数を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Beside the washing area, understood. I've checked the dry box too; how many layers of fruit can I stack?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check how many layers of fruit may go in the replacement box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日使う浅い箱は一段だけにします。押し込まず、実の間に少し余裕を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: For today's shallow boxes, only one layer. Don't push the fruit in; leave a little space between them.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一段で隙間を空けます。途中で箱がいっぱいになったら、誰に知らせればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 満杯の箱を交換する連絡相手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll use one layer with gaps. If the box fills up partway through, who should I tell?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whom to notify to replace a full box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この列の担当に声をかけてください。こちらから空箱を届けるので、箱を抱えて歩き回らなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Call the person in charge of this row. We'll bring an empty box to you, so you don't need to walk around carrying the full one.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 満杯になったら列の担当を呼びます。濡れた箱を分けてから、収穫に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 連絡方法と箱の交換後に作業へ戻ることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll call the row's staff member when it's full. I'll go back to harvesting after separating the wet box.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Explain the contact method and that you will return to work after changing boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お願いします。箱の交換を済ませて、気をつけて戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please do. Finish changing the box and return carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そのページは、文字の形にも注目できる展示です。読みにくい部分がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: This page also lets you pay attention to the shapes of the letters. Is any part hard to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 吹き出しの外にある「ざあっ」は、登場人物が言っている言葉ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 吹き出し外の効果音が発話か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is the 'zaa' outside the speech balloon something the character is saying?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether a sound effect outside a speech balloon is spoken dialogue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: このコマでは雨の音を表しています。人の言葉とは別に、場面の様子を伝えているんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: In this panel, it represents the sound of rain. Apart from people's words, it conveys the scene's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 雨の音なんですね。大きく斜めに書いてあるのも、強い雨だと伝えるためですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 文字の大きさと向きが雨の強さを示すか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: So it's rain. Is it also written large and diagonally to show heavy rain?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether the lettering size and angle show the rain's strength. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そのように読めますね。次のコマでは、人物が傘を開いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can read it that way. In the next panel, the character opens an umbrella.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 音の文字を読んでから絵を見ると、傘を開いた理由がわかります。次のコマも同じ順番で見ていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 音と絵を関連付ける読み方の継続を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Reading the sound lettering before looking at the picture helps me understand why they open the umbrella. May I look at the next panel in the same order?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether you can continue reading by relating the sounds to the pictures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、文字と絵を行き来してみてください。読む順は、右上のコマから左へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, try moving back and forth between the writing and pictures. The reading order goes leftward from the upper-right panel.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 左下まで来たら次のページですね。あの小さい「ぱっ」も、傘の動きを表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ページ順と傘の効果音の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Once I reach the bottom left, I go to the next page, right? Does that small 'pa' also represent the umbrella's movement?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about page order and the meaning of the umbrella's sound effect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ここでは傘が開く様子を表しています。音だけでなく、動きを表す文字もあるんですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here, it represents the umbrella opening. Some lettering represents movement, not just sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 雨の音と傘の動きを分けて読めました。別のページでも吹き出しの外に注目してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 音と動きの表現を区別できたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I was able to read the rain's sound separately from the umbrella's movement. I'll pay attention outside the speech balloons on other pages too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Explain that you could distinguish expressions of sound from movement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 新しい見方が見つかりましたね。それでは、ごゆっくり作品をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: You've found a new way of looking at it. Please take your time enjoying the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この机は展示品と同じ幅のものをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like this desk in the same width as the display model?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 幅はちょうどいいですが、玄関を通るか心配です。脚を外して運べる机ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 机の脚を外して搬入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The width is just right, but I'm worried whether it can get through my entrance. Can the legs be removed for moving it in?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the desk's legs can be removed for delivery inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この商品は脚を外せます。ただ、天板だけの大きさと玄関の曲がり角も確認したいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The legs on this product can be removed. However, we should also check the tabletop's dimensions and the corner at your entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 玄関は入ってすぐ右に曲がります。ドアの幅だけ測れば足りると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 玄関の曲がり角を説明し測定の不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You turn right immediately after entering. I thought measuring only the door width would be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Describe the entrance corner and explain that your measurements were insufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 曲がるための空間も必要です。天板の寸法を書きますので、通路の幅も測っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It needs turning space too. I'll write down the tabletop dimensions; could you measure the passage width as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通路も測ります。脚を取り付ける工具は、自分で用意する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 通路の測定を了承し組み立て工具の用意を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll measure the passage too. Do I need to prepare the tools for attaching the legs myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Agree to measure the passage and ask about preparing assembly tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 付属品の一覧には専用の工具が載っています。配送時の組み立てを頼む場合は、別に見積もりを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The accessories list includes a dedicated tool. If you want assembly on delivery, let's check a separate estimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 自分で組み立てる予定です。箱に入った状態の寸法も紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分で組み立てる意向と梱包寸法の記載を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I plan to assemble it myself. Could you also write the dimensions while it's in its box on the paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you intend to assemble it yourself and ask for the packaged dimensions in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 梱包寸法も並べて記入しますね。商品が通っても箱が通らない場合があるので、両方見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll write the packaged dimensions alongside them. Even if the product fits through, the box might not, so please check both.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 天板と箱の寸法を持ち帰って、曲がり角まで測ります。注文はその後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 商品と箱の寸法を持ち帰り測定後に注文すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll take the tabletop and box dimensions home and measure the corner too. I'll order after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Take the product and box dimensions home and say you will order after measuring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 寸法がそろえば、また一緒に確認できます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Once you have all the measurements, we can check together again. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 入口はこちらです。券を読み取る前に、ご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The entrance is here. Please have your ticket ready before scanning.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ入っていませんが、帽子を車に忘れました。先に取ってきてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未入園で帽子を取りに車へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I haven't entered yet, but I left my hat in the car. May I go and get it first?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not entered and want to return to the car for your hat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 読み取り前ですから、そのままお戻りください。お連れの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Since it hasn't been scanned, please go back as you are. Is anyone accompanying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 友人はもう中にいます。入口の外で待つよう連絡すると、出てしまうかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人が入園済みで外へ呼ぶと出てしまう懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: My friend is already inside. If I tell them to wait outside the entrance, they might come out.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend has entered and you are concerned that calling them outside would make them leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それなら、中の案内板の前で待ってもらうのはどうでしょう。入口を出る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then how about asking them to wait in front of the information board inside? They don't need to leave through the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 中の案内板で待ってもらいます。戻ったら、この列の最後に並べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人の待機場所と戻った際の並び方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll ask them to wait at the information board inside. When I come back, should I join the end of this line?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend's waiting place and how to queue when you return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、戻ったときの入園列にお並びください。券をなくさないよう、財布などにしまってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please join the entry line when you return. Keep your ticket in your wallet or somewhere safe so you don't lose it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 券は財布に入れました。駐車場へは、この歩行者用の通路を戻るんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 券の保管を伝え駐車場への歩行経路を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've put the ticket in my wallet. I follow this pedestrian path back to the car park, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you have stored the ticket and check the walking route to the car park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その通路で戻れます。車の出入口を横切るところでは、車が来ていないか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can return by that path. Where it crosses the car entrance and exit, please check for approaching cars.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 歩行者用の通路から帽子を取ってきます。友人にも中で待つよう連絡しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 帽子を取りに戻る行動と友人への連絡完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll go and get my hat using the pedestrian path. I've also told my friend to wait inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to get the hat and that you have contacted your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、足元と車に気をつけていってらっしゃい。戻られたら券をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then watch your step and look out for cars. Please show your ticket when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お待たせしました。お会計の明細をお持ちしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you for waiting. I've brought the itemized bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 最初に渡した割引券が、この明細に入っていないようです。見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会計明細に割引券が反映されていないと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The discount voucher I handed over at the beginning doesn't seem to be included on this bill. Could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Point out that the itemized bill does not reflect the discount voucher. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 失礼しました。券をお預かりした記録を確認しますので、まだお支払いなさらずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm sorry. I'll check the record of receiving your voucher, so please wait without paying yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この炒め物が割引の対象だと思っていました。飲み物には使えない券でしたよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 対象料理と飲み物の適用範囲を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought this stir-fry was eligible for the discount. The voucher couldn't be used for drinks, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the scope of eligibility for the dish and drinks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 券の表示では、この料理が対象で、飲み物は対象外となっています。料理の分を修正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The voucher says this dish is eligible and drinks aren't. I'll correct the dish portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 料理だけですね。修正前の紙は、こちらから返したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 訂正前の明細を返す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: So just the dish. Should I give you back the paper from before the correction?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the original itemized bill needs to be returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 回収させてください。新しい明細では、割引の行と合計額を一緒にご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please let me collect it. On the new bill, you can check the discount line and total together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 新しい明細では割引が入っています。支払いは、この合計額をカードでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 訂正額を確認してカード払いを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The new bill includes the discount. I'd like to pay this total by card.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the corrected amount and request card payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。端末の金額も同じかご覧になってから、カードをお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Please check that the terminal amount matches too before using your card.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 端末も同じ金額でした。レシートは割引が載ったものを持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 端末金額の一致と割引記載のレシートを持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: The terminal showed the same amount. I'll take home the receipt showing the discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm the terminal amount matches and say you will keep the receipt showing the discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: こちらがレシートです。お手数をおかけしました、どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Here's your receipt. Sorry for the trouble; please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 柵の前でお困りですか。こちらの通路は今、作業中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you having trouble by the barrier? This passage is currently a work area.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 遊具広場へ行きたいのですが、柵の横の隙間を通れば近いと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 遊具広場へ向かい柵の隙間を通ろうとしたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to go to the playground, and I thought going through the gap beside the barrier would be shorter.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you were about to use a barrier gap to reach the playground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その隙間には入らないでください。作業車が通るので、舗装された迂回路を使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please don't enter that gap. Work vehicles pass through, so use the paved detour.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 子どもと一緒なので、作業場所から離れて歩きます。迂回路は右の道ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 子ども連れで作業場所を避ける意思と迂回方向を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm with my child, so we'll walk away from the work area. Is the detour the path on the right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid the work area with your child and check the detour direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 右の道を進んで、ベンチの先で左に曲がってください。そこから遊具広場の入口が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Follow the right-hand path and turn left past the bench. You'll see the playground entrance from there.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ベンチの先で左ですね。帰りも同じ道を使えば、工事の通路を通らずに戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 曲がる位置を復唱し帰りの迂回経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Left past the bench, understood. If we use the same path back, can we return without going through the construction passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Repeat the turning point and ask about the return detour. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、同じ舗装路で戻れます。作業が続いている間は、入口の迂回表示も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, you can return by the same paved path. While work continues, check the detour signs at the entrance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 戻るときにも表示を見ます。子どもに、柵の内側には入らないと説明してから進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 帰りの表示確認と子どもへの立入禁止の説明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the signs when returning too. Before we go, I'll explain to my child that we mustn't go inside the barrier.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will check signs on the return and explain the no-entry rule to your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。もし道がわからなくなったら、柵を越えずにこの案内所まで戻ってきてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. If you lose your way, don't cross the barrier; come back to this information point.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 迷ったら案内所に戻ります。教えてもらった舗装路から広場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 迷った場合の対応を確認し舗装路へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: If we get lost, we'll return to the information point. We'll head for the playground using the paved path you showed us.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm what to do if lost and say you will take the paved path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、お子さんと気をつけていってらっしゃい。広場で楽しくお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-KURAYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then please take care with your child. Have a lovely time at the playground.
